subject: Superintendent Evaluation Timeline and Process
overview: The Superintendent Evaluation Subcommittee established a timeline and template process for the 2022–2023 superintendent evaluation and discussed evidence reporting for selected performance indicators.

items.title: Call to Order and Background
items.summary: Sharon Hays opened the meeting and reviewed recent School Committee actions establishing the evaluation subcommittee and process updates.

items.title: 2022–2023 Evaluation Timeline and Process
items.summary: The subcommittee approved scheduling a Committee of the Whole meeting for May 8, 2023, for the superintendent's self-evaluation presentation and template review, establishing a complete timeline through June 12.

items.title: Evidence for Evaluation Indicators
items.summary: The subcommittee and superintendent discussed DESE evidence examples and expectations for narrative context and data alignment across the selected indicators.
